newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 20.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* The Dow Jones industrial average on Tuesday soared to its 40th record close this year and long-term bond interest rates slid close to six percent on fresh signs that inflation is in check. The blue-chip Dow ended up 50.69 points at 6,397.60, setting its ninth record out of the past 10 trading sessions, and beating Friday's high of 6,348.03.
* President Suharto was quoted as saying on Tuesday that individual shareholdings should not exceed 15 percent in companies listed on Indonesia's stock exchanges.
* The Jakarta Composite Index fell 5.65 points, or 0.91 percent, to close at 615.21 points after touching an intra-day low of 613.38 points on profit taking.
* Brokers said the market was likely to be mixed at the opening on Wednesday on possible follow-through profit taking and fresh buying of selected counters, brokers said.
** On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2338.00/39.00 at 0140 GMT against the opening of 2,338.25/39.25.
* Property stocks on a news report that office occupancy rates were seen dropping four percent by the end of 1997 because of rising supply.

* Shoe manufacturers on news that Indonesia's shoe exports are expected to total $2.4 billion this year, up 20 percent from 1995. The head of the Shoe Manufacturers Association said exports were seen at least $2.8 billion rupiah in 1997.

* Cocoa producer Davomas Abadi on news reports it will invest $20 million to add one processing line with a production capacity of 20,000 tonnes per year which was scheduled to commence operations in 1997.
